rationale: The agent proceeded to execute the exchange and then stated it was “officially in motion” without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes. There’s no clear evidence of proper user authentication beyond using the provided email, and no explicit verification that the order belongs to the authenticated user was communicated. The agent also provided a specific refund amount ($7.99) without visible supporting tool results in the conversation. While the tool call list suggests an exchange was performed using the gift card, the lack of pre-action confirmation and unclear authentication mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
